findings.resolution: Added serialized status value assertions to the callback, outbound pipeline, and telephony reporter webhook tests while retaining status_event absence assertions.

The provider_status_reporter source assignment exists in merge base 2074a850048bd883a962278b6450d35a2b9639bf and was not added by this change. Removing it would violate the RFC requirement to leave other webhook fields unchanged.

Added verification and implementation review artifacts. The accepted RFC remains unchanged because its exact SHA-256 is recorded by the approved confirmation receipt and repository policy requires a new challenge and confirmation for any byte change. The confirmation artifact itself records approved status.
